rationale: The core short thesis remains structurally intact — ECO is still well below its prior close (~$95.66), the intraday rally failed below that level near today's $95.60 high, and price is parked essentially at session VWAP ($92.87 vs $92.93), so the failed-bounce setup is being retested rather than invalidated. The $93.55 invalidation has not been touched, and the remaining reward-to-risk to the $89.60 target (~4.8:1) does not justify closing a fractional -0.27% loss or paying the wide 54 bps spread to flip long against a heavy-volume gap-down tape.
